name: Exception Path — 8-Week Deadline Breach
description: Complaint not resolved within 8 weeks. A Holding Response is dispatched to the customer granting immediate FOS referral rights. Compliance incident raised.

steps.action: Scheduled job detects ComplaintCase with target_resolution_date exceeded and status != closed
Publish ComplaintClosed (EVT-141) { response_type: holding_response, outcome: null }
Consume EVT-141 → Dispatch Holding Response: apology, immediate FOS referral right, FOS contact details
Consume EVT-141 → Detect response_type=holding_response → Raise DISP SLA breach incident
Alert: DISP 8-week SLA breach for COMP-YYYYMMDD-NNNN. Immediate escalation required.
